name: Haus Mühlanger
beschreibung: Haus Mühlanger in Tirol is located in a quiet location on the edge of the village with views of the surrounding mountain panorama. The spacious rooms are furnished in a traditional country-house style and have a balcony. The culinary offerings include a breakfast buffet with regional products; half board is served on request. In the immediate surroundings, numerous hiking and mountain biking trails are available in summer. Winter sports enthusiasts can reach the nearby ski areas in a short time. The special atmosphere of the house is characterized by personal hospitality and a cozy ambience.
